use_cases: Displaying AI processing status with animated progress ring to keep users informed during long operations
Showing multi-step task sequences with status messages and sub-tasks during AI computations
Providing visual feedback for web search, analysis, and UI enhancement workflows
Enhancing user experience with smooth animated loading states in AI-powered applications
Indicating progress for background operations like caching, optimization, and performance testing
ai_summary: An AI loading state component featuring an animated SVG circular progress indicator that cycles through predefined task sequences including web searching, result analysis, and UI/UX enhancement. The component displays dynamic status messages with nested task lines to keep users informed during multi-step AI operations, designed with a clean minimalist aesthetic suitable for SaaS and developer tools interfaces.
